exact_statement: For the marked edge 03 in K5 minus edge 34, on the stabilizer slice c=d=e=1 with free real orbit weights (a,b), classify the connected component of P(a,b)>0 containing (1,1), and determine the sign of xi(a,b) throughout that component.
source: Local exact orbit polynomial derived in amra-research-loop/campaigns/opg-1757-k5-cross-round3; scoped continuation of OPG problem 1757.
scope_notes: This is the complete real connected-component question only on c=d=e=1 with free (a,b).
The anchor is (a,b)=(1,1), where P=128 and xi=58.
No claim is made about the other three stabilizer variables, the transverse directions, G201, or OPG-1757.
